description: Use when an agent must pick a paid x402 API for a task. Input: q (task in plain words or keywords), optional max_price (USD), network (base, solana or CAIP-2), limit (1-20). Output: JSON ranked endpoints: resource URL, method, description, price, networks, seller, 30-day payers and calls (Bazaar), seller buyers (x402scan), wash/quality flags, score, index as_of. Same rules for every seller. Example: ?q=base+token+honeypot+check&max_price=0.02 Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

include_flagged.description: false drops routes flagged scanner_like or uniform_payers (suspected probes / wash); default true (flagged routes are kept but ranked lower)

max_price.description: Only endpoints priced at or below this many USD per call

network.description: Only endpoints that accept this network: base, solana, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, ethereum, avalanche, worldchain, monad, or a CAIP-2 id (eip155:8453)

q.description: What the API should do, in plain words or keywords (e.g. 'korean apartment prices', 'convert pdf to markdown'). Text only: never fetched as a URL

name: x402_api_recommend
title: x402 API finder: ranked paid endpoints for a task, with demand and quality flags
